pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark pigment regions exhibit high edge angularity with sharp pixel gradients. The geometry consists of irregular polygons with jagged, serrated perimeters. Patch area is significantly larger on the cervical region and diminishes in size towards the posterior and ventral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological network characterized by frequent triple-junction nodes. The pathways maintain a narrow, relatively uniform pixel thickness across the torso, ensuring high continuity between individual patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour. The edge consists of dense, repetitive vertical projections of hair follicles creating a jagged boundary against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, circular raised nodule is visible on the mid-lateral flank. Multiple thin, linear, light-colored horizontal striations consistent with superficial scarring are distributed across the posterior flank patches.
